Message:
scsi: megaraid_sas: Set no_write_same only for Virtual Disk

Disable WRITE_SAME (no_write_same) for Virtual Disks only.  For System PDs
and EPDs (Enhanced PDs), WRITE_SAME need not be disabled by default.
